plugins.name: turn-band
plugins.description: Mod: shows how long the last turn took above the prompt; /turn-band brings it back after hiding.

plugins.name: agents-live
plugins.description: Mod: a live pane of this session's subagents with status, type, model, tool calls and time; /agents-live opens it, /pane-check says whether panes can show.

plugins.name: weather-pane
plugins.description: Mod: current weather and a 5-day forecast in a side pane and a line above the prompt; /weather <city> picks the place.

plugins.name: progress-tracker
plugins.description: Mod: a progress bar above the prompt for Claude's task list; /progress opens the full list in a pane.
